ruleDefinitions.name: Unsigned AppX Installation Attempt Using Add-AppxPackage - PsScript
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the "Add-AppxPackage" or it's alias "Add-AppPackage" to install unsigned AppX packages Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Add\\-AppPackage\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Add\\-AppxPackage\\ .*")) AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-AllowUnsigned.*"))
